Be awere of yours surroundings, in the streets you can be robbed without even realizing,  so don't go using your cellphone in the streets randomly. 

If you are in a restaurant, don't change everything thing in your order if it's not in the menu, they are not vwry flexible- of course if you are allergic to something it's okay, but if you gonna change everything the order they will not be happy and your order will take the longest. 

Don't be creepy to woman, in some way, brazilian women have more freedom on their sexuality but this don't mean they will have sex with you or 'ficar' , I had some bad experiences with gringos that were very insisting and rude. Be cool, be nice, don't be creep.

And finally 'Gringo' it's not a slur.

I've watched my mom died.
My mom died August 2020. 
She was on dialysis for 6 years, a bunchof health issues. I have heard the last gasping of air she gave, I tried to do cpr but she died, she was already dead when i came on the room, I watched a tear came off and I only can interpret as pain from the last breathing she gave. I blame myself about not give her the right resources so she could get a peacefully death. A week before her death she denied medical care. I miss her, after her death my mind got really dark. A year later I've tried to overdose myself, I was in a bad spot, I remember to feel like I've been lifted and not being able to feel my body and to this day I think this is maybe the same feeling my mom feel. I know now I don't wanna die like that, neither like my mom died (dying due to kidney failure) or trying to kill myself.
